figurative_meaning_en: squandering or wasteful spending (especially of money)
similar_in_english: burning a hole in one's pocket
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার সঞ্চয় নয়ছয় করে ফেলেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Unnecessary expenses are like throwing money away.
note: The idiom likely derives from playful numerical sounds implying frivolous calculation or loss in expenditure.
